import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Pre-processing
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', style='Education', palette='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Customization
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending by Marital Status and Education', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Marital Status / Education', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
